otherClaims.name: OpenAI warrant: up to 160M shares at $0.01, exercisable through 2030-10-05
otherClaims.basis: fair value NOT disclosed; 10-K states the issuance had no impact on the financial statements and no warrant shares met vesting or exercise conditions at 2025-12-27. Vests in tranches on OpenAI/affiliate AMD Instinct GPU purchase milestones (6 GW deployment, first 1 GW on MI450), specified AMD stock price targets and stock performance; each vested tranche further subject to technical and commercial conditions. To be accounted for as a liability until equity-classification conditions are met. Value is null because no fair value is disclosed; this does not imply zero economic worth (up to 160M shares is about 9.8% of shares outstanding).

ttm.note: Latest filed 10-Q is Q2 2026 (period ended 2026-06-27, filed 2026-08-05). Operating lease liabilities understated by the undisclosed current portion (about $159M a year earlier; new data-center leases of $4.5B not yet commenced plus $9.5B signed after quarter end). Non-marketable equity investments $1.7B are disclosed rounded. Other post-period items: investment commitments of up to $5.0B through fiscal 2028 (Note 8), $4.1B maximum-exposure lease guarantees recorded as an immaterial credit derivative (guarantees may be issued in exchange for warrants), unconditional purchase commitments $30,276M (Note 10). Revolver now $5.0B and CP program $5.5B, both undrawn.

notes: Fiscal year ends the last Saturday of December. FY2025 = year ended 2025-12-27; TTM runs to the Q2 2026 quarter end 2026-06-27.
Flows are from continuing operations (ZT Systems manufacturing business discontinued; settled ZT contingent consideration in Oct 2025).

No convertible notes, capped calls, NCI or preferred. The two customer warrants (OpenAI Oct 2025, Meta Feb 2026; 160M shares each at $0.01) are the only material dilutive claims and none had vested by 2026-06-27.
Reviewed package (dist/data/incremental-AMD-2026-10-18-v3) was used for orientation; all figures here were taken directly from the 10-K and 10-Q.
